limits: Whole-event deletion #3719 remains reproducible when surviving records are self-consistent.
Mutable ledger and output hashes are not independent trust anchors; coordinated rewrite remains outside guarantee.
REVIEWED_TREE is an output declaration; no proof of actual code review or coverage of uncommitted content.
Hash normalizes CRLF and trailing whitespace; not byte-exact identity.
verify clean may include unavailable coverage.
decision: Trial the bounded consistency check; do not adopt a whole stack default or upgrade reader status.
raw_report_timing_note: The preserved REPORT.txt header predates supplemental checks. Use command timestamps and consumer fields above, not the old report header, for actual execution times.
